scope: Value residual fused into FP32 recurrence; shared decode optimization for BF16 and experimental INT8 FFN. Overall FP16/INT8 hardware-limit goal remains active.
hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / XDNA2 AIE2P / 8 columns / performance power mode / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / project-locked MLIR-AIE and Peano
changes: Fuse noninitial-layer value residual into recurrence preparation, preserving the scalar arithmetic order and FP32 recurrent state
Seven lanes distribute heads as 5/5/5/5/4/4/4; 14 state/aux input streams plus one first-value broadcast fit the 16 shim MM2S channels
Store raw value, projected value gate and bias in three tail vectors of the recurrence arena; preserve their diagnostic aliases
Only the original 27 recurrence vectors flow downstream and return to DDR; no redundant raw value writeback
Remove standalone production value dispatch and its 23 separate BOs; standalone value compiler retained only for diagnostic switching experiment
Add switching-aware stage timing, fused oracle/guards, hardware CTest entry, and trace for the production seven-lane topology

profiling_before_change.experiment: A/B/B/A, 300 samples per process, four warmup executions; fixed synthetic recurrent state reset outside timer
profiling_before_change.interpretation: Alternating with the value program raises recurrence wall time from about 1.00 to 2.33 ms, while host submit is about 4 us. Difference includes context/PDI scheduling and possible cache/DMA effects; it is not an isolated PDI counter.

experiments.four_lane: Passed oracle/guards; a first three-input-per-core attempt exceeded DMA placement capacity and was replaced by memory-tile joining. Four-lane fused isolated mean 2.138 ms and switched mean 2.985 ms; superseded by seven lanes.
experiments.seven_lane: Passed oracle/guards; isolated mean 1.412 ms and switched mean 2.648 ms before removing unused tail writeback.
experiments.note: Pair timing includes the priming value dispatch. For fused variants, mean_us excludes that unrelated priming dispatch. Synthetic stage timings are not whole-model performance.

whole_model_benchmark.conditions: Serial hardware runs, profiling disabled, no concurrent compilation. Preserved pre-fusion executable versus new executable; shared matrix artifacts.

validation.build: Full release-int8-ffn-kernels preset succeeded; fresh default artifacts dispatched and checked
validation.scope: Exact 128-token same-precision snapshots check 1116 vectors including 960 first-token nodes, logits/state checkpoints, reset/branch, invalid inputs and host state API. Independent FP64 stage oracle retains original tolerances and checks BO guards, preserved value inputs, immutable first-value input.

resources.traffic_note: Derived from compiled DMA element counts, not measured bandwidth or total model traffic. BO bytes and host traffic are unchanged; input packing eliminates root allocations rather than storage.

current_int8_profile.scope: Host-observed wall time including scheduling, switching, DMA and compute; not pure device compute latency.

data.scope: Marked execution on selected cores; excludes waiting for initial activation. Fractions overlap; vector issue is not peak-compute utilization.

current_device_trace.scope: Production seven-lane topology at -Os, with diagnostic trace egress. First lane only: five complete head calls on each of three cores. Markers exclude FIFO acquire/release. Trace can perturb execution; vector issue is not peak FLOPS utilization and these cores do not represent the full array.

limitations_and_next_work: IEEE FP16 remains unresolved: current half precision is BF16; no claim that the IEEE FP16 requirement is met
INT8 remains experimental FFN-only W8A16, with representative held-out corpus and long-context quality gates pending
Prefill benchmark still measures sequential resident replay; batched NPU prefill remains required
Trace identifies prepare/value scalar math as about 8.3 times the state-update cycles; profile and vectorize this arithmetic while preserving numerical stability
Continue reducing program switches and measure actual DMA bandwidth, scheduling stalls and full-array utilization
No architectural roofline or negligible-further-improvement claim; four process runs per precision do not establish confidence intervals
